dataset.name: ISIMIP dengue harmonized (LAO)
dataset.description: Dengue cases with ERA5-Land climate and WorldPop population for Laos, from chap-core's full_data.tar.gz.
dataset.notes: Dropped the pandas index column (first, unnamed) from the source file; otherwise unchanged.
dataset.schema_status: filled from chap-core build code and data checks; not independently verified

fields.name: time_period
fields.description: Calendar month (YYYY-MM), built from the year and month columns of dengue_data_ISIMIP.csv.

fields.name: rainfall
fields.description: Total precipitation summed over the month, averaged over the admin polygon.

source.notes: chap-core climate_health/google_earth_engine/gee_era5.py at f02e58952 (commit that added full_data.tar.gz; file later removed): daily total_precipitation_sum summed per month, polygon mean, m converted to mm; CSV median 113 mm/month

fields.name: mean_temperature
fields.description: Mean 2m temperature over the month (mean of daily values), averaged over the admin polygon.

source.notes: chap-core climate_health/google_earth_engine/gee_era5.py at f02e58952 (commit that added full_data.tar.gz; file later removed): daily temperature_2m averaged per month, polygon mean, K converted to °C; CSV range 12.4 to 29.7

fields.name: population
fields.description: Population estimate for the admin unit (population_worldpop column of dengue_data_ISIMIP.csv); gaps linearly interpolated, so values are non-integer.

source.notes: Via dengue_data_ISIMIP.csv population_worldpop, renamed and gaps interpolated (np.interp) in chap-core scripts/full_dataset.py

fields.name: location
fields.description: Admin-1 unit name from the admin1 column of dengue_data_ISIMIP.csv, transliterated to ASCII with words capitalized and spaces removed.

source.notes: chap-core scripts/full_dataset.py normalize_name(); names matched to admin-1 polygons (NAME_1/VARNAME_1) for climate extraction; 7 admin-1 units, a subset of the country's provinces/states
